newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Maintains tightening bias.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Maintains tightening bias.

text.p: The Australian bond market on Friday maintained Thursday's narrowing bias against the dollar bloc, particularly against North American currencies.

A strong rally in the U.S. on Thursday after a barrage of U.S. data indicated that inflation was well under control was seen negating the need for a Fed tightening in the short term, and fuelled thoughts of another RBA easing.

The local market has started to build in a loosening in current 5.0 percent official interest after Thursday's benign wages data. The largest move was against Canada, which also lagged the rally in the U.S. on Thursday.
However, the New Zealand market held its ground against Australia, ignoring a slightly stronger than expected June quarter retail sales report.
